import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprogram', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def synth(h,w,rr,cc,base,sep,nodes):
    g=[[base]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in rr:
        for c in range(w): g[r][c]=sep
    for c in cc:
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=sep
    for i,r in enumerate(rr):
        for j,c in enumerate(cc):g[r][c]=nodes[i][j]
    return g
n1=[[0,0,9,9,9],[0,0,3,3,9],[7,7,3,3,9],[7,7,7,7,9],[7,7,7,7,9],[7,7,9,9,9]]
